name: Dimensional Power
text: Damage from all of your attacks is increased by $s1%.
notes: Power Pylon. D3Planner shrineBuffs pylon_damage text. The x5 is a factor of its own in step 8 of the hit (dc_pylons.cpp Multipliers). Donor Death Wish, for its icon.

name: Dimensional Conduit
text: Lightning zaps your surroundings, causing massive damage to nearby enemies.
notes: Conduit Pylon. D3's text (pylon_electrified) without "and obstacles": nothing breakable exists yet (roadmap Beta), so the sentence would promise it; the breakables task restores it. The strikes are part P2 (diablocraft-eok78): this record's effect is the stock periodic dummy, its period pylon_conduit_pulse_ms, and each strike is record 83511. Donor Lightning Shield.

name: Dimensional Channeling
text: All resource costs are removed, and cooldowns reduced by $s1%.
notes: Channeling Pylon (pylon_casting). Cooldowns running when it is taken reset at once (dc_pylons.cpp Give); costs and cooldowns are Temporary sheet contributions and the class's own two modifier auras are rebuilt. Donor Presence of Mind.

name: Dimensional Shield
text: Invulnerable to all damage and all control impairing effects.
notes: Shield Pylon (pylon_invulnerable) without "Incoming damage is redirected to nearby enemies": the reflect was removed in patch 2.6.1 and is not built (pylons.md 6.3). The record carries the stock all-school immunity and the stock all-controls immunity (the set Ignore Pain uses); DealMonsterHit, Knockback and Vortex ask for it by name (Pylons::Shielded). Donor Divine Shield.

name: Dimensional Speed
text: Your movement speed is increased by $s1% and attack speed by $s2%. Can pass through enemies, knocking them up into the air.
notes: Speed Pylon (pylon_running) without D3's "damaging" and its Waller sentence: the knock-up (part P2, diablocraft-eok78) is its own hidden aura beside this one (83512) so leaving the rift can take only it, and deals no damage until the designer sets pylon_speed_knockup_weapon_damage_pct; Waller is not built. Movement is a Temporary contribution, which the sheet does not cap. Donor Sprint.

name: Blessed
text: You take $s1% less damage from attacks.
notes: Blessed Shrine (shrine_blessed; D3 now calls the shrine Protection and keeps this buff name). Donor Blessing of Kings.

name: Empowered
text: Your resource regeneration is increased by $s1% and your cooldowns are reduced by $s2%.
notes: Empowered Shrine (shrine_empowered). Effect 1 is the stock percent power-regeneration aura on Energy, effect 3 the same on Mana, so every class's own resource that regenerates doubles and the Barbarian's Fury, which only skills generate, gets the cooldowns alone; effect 2 carries the cooldown number (a Temporary contribution). Donor Innervate.

name: Enlightened
text: You gain $s1% more experience from monsters you kill.
notes: Enlightened Shrine (shrine_enlightened). A factor on the wearer's own kill XP after the sheet's gear bonus (dc_paragon.cpp SheetAward). Donor Inner Focus.

name: Fleeting
notes: Fleeting Shrine (shrine_fleeting) without the pickup radius sentence: nothing is picked up by walking near it yet (pylons.md 6.2); the pickup task restores it. Donor Ghost Wolf.

name: Fortune
text: Your chance to find magic items is increased by $s1% and to find gold by $s2%.
notes: Fortune Shrine (shrine_fortune; D3's one sentence states the two as one number, ours are two rows). Donor Arcane Intellect.

name: Frenzied
text: Your attack rate is increased by $s1%.
